name: DingTalk Notifier
description: Push mail alerts to a DingTalk group robot webhook
author: MailFlow community
readme:
# DingTalk Notifier

Registers the notifier component id `dingtalk`. Options: `access_token` (robot webhook token) or `webhook_url` (full URL), optional `secret` (sign), `timeout_seconds`. Sends `msgtype=text` with the mail summary.
